+# Issue #73 — independent proactive visual QA
+
+[Persist and reconcile an isolated mock workspace through the shared facade](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/73)
+
+Reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High**. Review date: 2026-10-25, Asia/Qyzylorda. Code baseline: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. The supplied live issue snapshot is closed, has no discussion comments, and records delivery in `7845b84`; that historical acceptance was not treated as fresh proof. Existing dirty documentation, skills and historical evidence were preserved. No product, specification, Git index, commit, remote or issue changes were made. Only this issue-73 evidence directory was written.
+
+**Verdict: one confirmed recoverability defect; two separate usability findings.** No cross-account leakage or duplicate-effect defect was observed in this bounded review. Counts: HIGH 0, MEDIUM 2, LOW 1. This report does not reopen or reaccept the issue.
+
+## Purpose and boundary
+
+This is a technical foundation, with no standalone interface. Its user job is to keep a saved video/project/account fact consistent after reload, account changes and interrupted acknowledgements. Projects and the protected-route error surface demonstrate visible consequences. UI findings below identify consumer/shared-design ownership rather than inventing a #73 screen redesign obligation.
+
+Authority read: issue snapshot `contracts/issue-73.md`; HANDOFF and SDD entry points; shared contract; Record's durable candidate/accepted-take distinction; Result's revision/idempotent generation handoff; Credits' authoritative balance and durable return context; current Affect adoption, reference catalog, workflow and tokens. Ponytail, spec-task-review, design-taste-frontend/app-screen guidance and frontend-design informed the two review lenses. The source BTN Clean Markdown and matching `button/Clean/Light/01-initial.png` were inspected. Generic design-skill defaults did not override Mabry/Clean/Light.
+
+## Fresh execution and provenance
+
+- Windows, installed Playwright Chromium **156.0.8078.4**, headless, light surface. Unique mock-only Vite origin `http://127.0.0.1:4373`, explicit frontend cwd. Browser args mute audio and use fake media devices/UI. No physical microphone interaction.
+- `node _docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/capture.cjs`: final run completed, eight captures. Earlier EN-to-RU transition incorrectly changed only local locale storage; the script was corrected to use Account's actual locale selector. Only the final trace/metrics underpin findings.
+- `node _docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/retry-probe.cjs`: completed, two captures and transient-failure trace. Its initial default-locale attempt was interrupted and rerun with explicit en-US.
+- `npm.cmd test -- tests/services/default-client-persistence.test.ts tests/services/workspace-write-failures.test.ts tests/services/credit-reservation-concurrency.test.ts tests/services/account-deletion-late-work.test.ts`: **4 files / 4 tests passed**, 2.78s, 13:37:52 local.
+- `npm.cmd test -- tests/services/adapter-contract.test.ts tests/services/preparation-recovery.test.ts`: **2 files / 14 tests passed**, 2.22s, 13:38:58 local. Existing tests were executed unchanged. These are bounded mock/fake-IDB checks, not a browser quota or distributed-service test.
+- [Raw DOM measurements](metrics.json), [browser/facade trace](capture-log.json), [transient retry trace](retry-probe.json), and [fresh screenshot SHA-256 manifest](screenshot-manifest.json). All ten screenshots were opened with view_image and visually inspected. No old screenshots are counted.
+
+Primary journey used actual UI registration with visible simulated verification code, actual permitted MP4 upload, saved-source acknowledgement, Projects navigation, reload, Sign out, second-account registration, and Account's RU preference. Browser-side facade reads were added solely for inspection; their results are in capture-log.json. No real email, provider or backend was contacted. The primary-page request observer recorded no external request.
+
+## Expected versus observed
+
+| Contract/state | Expected | Fresh observed result and limits |
+|---|---|---|
+| AC-01 committed reload | Restore saved account/project/media facts without implying uncommitted bytes survived | **Confirmed for one uploaded source.** Before/after reload project ID, source ID, revision and selection agree. `uploads.getSource` returns 217,356 bytes and the expected 8,625ms source facts; current account/session remain present. Screens 01–03. No fresh take/result-byte reload journey here. |
+| AC-02 account isolation | Account B does not inherit A's library or read A's project | **Confirmed for two UI-created accounts in one isolated browser profile.** B's list is empty, used slots are 0/2, and `projects.open(A.id)` returns `not-found`. Screens 04–05. Not a production security claim. |
+| AC-02 reconciliation/concurrency | Same-operation replay, conflicts and stale work do not create contradictory facts | **Partial fresh proof.** Six existing targeted files passed, including adapter/recovery, concurrent reservations and late-account-deletion checks. `operations.resolve` for a fresh absent ID returns `not-started` and safe same-ID retry. Source transaction/operation audit supports this design. No exhaustive browser race matrix. |
+| AC-03 isolation/reset/scenarios | Explicit mock namespace, deterministic fixtures, no arbitrary provider fallback | **Source-confirmed, narrowly observed.** `index.ts:57–70` constructs `dubbed.mock.v1.<namespace>`; `mock-workspace.ts:7–18` resets that context database; real adapter construction throws. Harness uses a separate random namespace. No fresh reset-while-multiple-tabs-open exercise. |
+| AC-04 partial write/quota | Retain previous committed records and offer honest recoverable errors | **Partial.** Existing quota rollback regression passed. Persistent read/open fault yields localized errors, with no false library data (06–07). A one-shot open failure exposes an ineffective Retry (QA-73-01). Actual browser quota was not filled. |
+| Unknown deletion consumer | Keep outcome uncertain and reconcile instead of blindly deleting again | **Visible response confirmed using labelled synthetic injection.** Harness substitutes `projects.delete -> unknown`, not a real committed/deleted record. RU dialog keeps the project visible behind it and offers Check deletion (08). It does not prove persistence or successful reconciliation. |
+
+Source audit: `indexeddb.ts:117–143` waits for transaction completion and aborts failed work; `mock-store.ts:420–457` resolves active account/session and enforces project ownership; `mutations.ts:46–94` stores operation and domain writes together, compares request/kind, checks ownership and separates unknown-after-commit; `mock-operations.ts:9–31` returns only the current account's operation. These references explain the bounded runtime results; screenshots alone cannot establish atomicity or race prevention.
+
+## Findings
+
+### QA-73-01 — MEDIUM — Retry cannot recover a failed database open
+
+**Classification:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-04, protected routes consuming the substrate. Cause spans persistent mock initialization and shared error recovery.
+
+**Reproduce:** run retry-probe.cjs. It wraps native IndexedDB so only the first database open fails with an explicitly injected `InvalidStateError`. Every later open delegates to native IndexedDB. Navigate directly to Projects, then press the offered Retry once. The trace shows `opens: 1` both before and after Retry and identical blocked content. Reload then reaches the actual Sign in screen with a successful native open. The fault itself is synthetic; the retry wiring and page are real.
+
+**Expected:** after a transient storage-open condition clears, the offered recovery should reopen storage and retry the safe identity read, or explicitly offer Reload page. **Actual:** Retry reuses the rejected initialization promise, so it cannot make progress even though the fault is gone.
+
+**Source:** `frontend/src/services/index.ts:61` stores one `openWorkspaceDatabase` promise; `frontend/src/services/mock-store.ts:500–506` always awaits the same promise; `frontend/src/app/FeatureRoute.tsx:109–114` retries only `refreshIdentity`. A fresh page creates a fresh service context, explaining recovery.
+
+**Impact:** an otherwise recoverable startup failure traps users behind an apparently actionable button until they independently reload. This is not evidence of destroyed committed data. **Recommendation:** make this recovery path recreate/reopen a failed connection safely, or label and perform a page reload. Add one bounded one-shot-open-failure regression that clicks the actual recovery action and reaches sign-in/project state without changing operation identity or replaying a mutation.
+
+![Retry remains blocked after the transient fault clears](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/evidence/09-transient-open-retry-stuck-en-desktop.png)
+
+![Reload recovers using native storage](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/evidence/10-transient-open-reload-recovers-en-desktop.png)
+
+### QA-73-02 — MEDIUM — Desktop resume action is disproportionately small
+
+**Classification:** requirement/design flaw, faithfully implemented by the Projects consumer. **Affected:** visible resume consequences of AC-01; shared density/Projects ownership, not a #73 persistence invariant failure.
+
+**Reproduce:** upload the fixture, open Projects at 1440×900 or 1440×700, and inspect the row's Continue action. **Measured:** Continue is **24px high with 12px text**; nearby rename/menu actions are 32px high and New dub is 28px. The same compact geometry survives reload. The row and surrounding canvas have ample space. Source: `ProjectsScreen.tsx:630–637` explicitly chooses `size="small"`; Clean BTN allows 24px / 12px, so this is not falsely called a source mismatch or automatically an accessibility violation.
+
+**Expected quality:** resuming saved work should be easy to locate and click as the row's most frequent action. **Actual:** the text action recedes beside the title and small metadata, and has a shorter target than the secondary icon actions. Interpretation: the global adoption of the smallest source recipe is an unnecessarily dense choice for this sparse working screen.
+
+**Impact:** extra pointer precision and weaker next-step hierarchy, especially for repeated resume use. **Recommendation:** retain Mabry, outlined Clean styling and quiet palette, but use at least the 32px recipe or a bounded 36–40px interaction target for frequent desktop row actions, with appropriate text size. Validate actual click geometry and long RU labels at desktop/short widths; preserve 48px phone targets. Coordinate with Projects/shared-control owners rather than enlarging every control indiscriminately.
+
+![Saved project resume action at desktop size](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/evidence/01-committed-en-desktop.png)
+
+![The same sparse row in the short desktop viewport](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/evidence/03-reloaded-en-short.png)
+
+### QA-73-03 — LOW — Read/startup failure claims a save failed
+
+**Classification:** requirement/design flaw in generic failure-copy mapping. **Affected:** AC-04's honest error communication; shared service notice/identity consumer.
+
+**Reproduce:** fail IndexedDB open before visiting protected Projects (capture.cjs's explicitly labelled fault). No user mutation is attempted. **Actual EN:** “The browser could not save this change. Check storage and try again.” RU similarly says an edit could not be saved. **Expected:** state that the local workspace/session could not be opened or read, distinguish that from a failed write, and provide a concrete safe recovery action.
+
+**Source:** `frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts:64` is the generic storage message; `FeatureRoute.tsx:109–113` passes the identity-read error to ServiceNotice; `components/ui/notice.tsx:27–38` maps by code alone. **Impact:** users arriving only to view their work can wrongly think an edit was lost; “check storage” gives little actionable guidance. This does not establish actual loss. **Recommendation:** add a read/open context message with Reload/Retry appropriate to QA-73-01, while retaining explicit write-failure wording for writes. Validate EN/RU startup and mutation failures separately.
+
+![Read failure uses write-oriented English wording](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/evidence/06-storage-unavailable-en-desktop.png)
+
+![Russian phone error remains readable but has the same semantic problem](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/evidence/07-storage-unavailable-ru-phone.png)
+
+## What works visually
+
+All eight main captures report Mabry loaded and document width equal to viewport width. The 390px RU empty library and storage failure have no horizontal overflow; main action targets measure 48px. The saved project's title/status/capacity remain stable through reload. B's empty library stays honestly empty rather than showing synthetic sample projects. The unknown-deletion presentation explicitly avoids claiming success, refund or physical erasure. Its phone dialog remains inside the viewport and its action target is 48px. Source treatment is recognizable: quiet white/hairline surfaces, radius-6 compact controls, dark primary, and outlined icon geometry. This is a scoped visual comparison, not an all-state fidelity verdict.
+
+![Real account B has an empty library on RU phone](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/evidence/05-account-b-empty-ru-phone.png)
+
+![Synthetic unknown deletion remains explicitly unconfirmed](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-73/evidence/08-injected-unknown-delete-ru-phone.png)
+
+The synthetic dialog repeats the uncertainty in two notices and is rather dense; consolidation is an optional consumer refinement, not another prioritized finding or substrate defect.
+
+## Explicit coverage gaps
+
+This bounded review did not run the full suite, exhaustively interleave races, fill real browser quota, restart the browser/OS, test private browsing/eviction/version migration, or verify Safari/iOS/physical devices, server security, cross-device media durability or providers. It did not repeat all Record/Result bytes and recovery workflows, inspect every unknown outcome, or perform fresh reset/concurrent-reset scenarios. Desktop evidence is primarily EN and phone evidence RU; EN phone, RU desktop, 767/768, 200% zoom, keyboard focus/forced colors, reduced motion, pending/error variants and dialog dismissal were not comprehensively checked for this nonvisual foundation. Existing passing tests cover specific simulations, not those missing browser checks.
+
+No evidence here supports a claim of production data damage or a security breach. Broader AC-02/AC-04 acceptance remains bounded by the referenced targeted mock tests and the stated browser observations. The actionable next verification is the one-shot-open recovery case, not a full-suite rerun by default.
